mod wechat_calls | - | Voice-session and media building blocks without devices or persistence.
mod wechat_calls::audio | - | Owned PCM and codec interfaces shared by native and hosted implementations.
mod wechat_calls::conference_media | #[cfg(all(feature = \"native-runtime\", not(target_arch = \"wasm32\")))] | Authenticated conference source decoding. Devices, sockets and persistence belong to the embedding runtime; no packet can announce its own participant.
mod wechat_calls::conference_send | #[cfg(all(feature = \"native-runtime\", not(target_arch = \"wasm32\")))] | One paced conference uplink. Application interruption never resets crypto counters or the presentation clock. Missing application audio becomes silence.
mod wechat_calls::mixer | - | PCM mixing on a shared presentation clock. This module owns no timer or device: the consumer supplies the due sample offset after its alignment delay.
mod wechat_calls::opus | #[cfg(all(feature = \"native-opus\", not(target_arch = \"wasm32\")))] | Optional native libopus implementation of the portable audio interfaces.
mod wechat_calls::ordering | - | Drop-late ordering for authenticated ordinary95 audio primaries.
mod wechat_calls::pcm_output | - | Generation-scoped PCM chunk admission and framing, independent of sockets.
mod wechat_calls::playout | - | Queue and pacing policy without a timer or executor dependency.
mod wechat_calls::tone | - | Synthetic pulsed PCM for an operator-approved audio check.
mod wechat_calls::track_queue | - | Independent audio budgets with ordered, non-droppable track controls. The host supplies synchronization and wakeups; this queue opens no runtime.
struct wechat_calls::audio::AudioFormat | struct { private fields } | Interleaved signed 16-bit PCM, grouped into fixed-duration frames.
struct wechat_calls::audio::AudioFrame | struct { public fields } | An owned frame. Generation fences queued output after interruption; timestamp is the stream's sample-frame position per channel, not wall-clock time.

struct wechat_calls::mixer::MixerMetrics | struct { public fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_calls::mixer::PcmMixer | struct { private fields } | A fixed-format mixer with separate queue budgets for each receive track. Missing/muted tracks contribute silence. Rendering never waits for a source.
struct wechat_calls::opus::OpusDecoder | struct { private fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_calls::opus::OpusEncoder | struct { private fields } | MISSING DOC

struct wechat_calls::pcm_output::PcmOutput | struct { private fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_calls::playout::AudioQueue | struct { private fields } | Fixed-frame PCM queue. Clearing starts a new output generation, so delayed producers cannot refill it with the interrupted response.
struct wechat_calls::playout::FramePacer | struct { private fields } | One frame per interval using host-supplied monotonic elapsed time. If the host stalls, skip elapsed slots instead of transmitting a catch-up burst. This schedules media; it does not implement network congestion control.
struct wechat_calls::playout::QueueMetrics | struct { public fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_calls::tone::PulseTone | struct { private fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_calls::track_queue::TrackQueue | struct<A, E> { private fields } | Controls are drained before audio. Audio pressure drops only that source's oldest waiting frame; it cannot consume another source's budget or a control.
trait wechat_calls::audio::AudioDecoder | trait | Decode only packets admitted by the authenticated transport. Empty packets are rejected; concealment is a separate deliberate operation by the host.
trait wechat_calls::audio::AudioEncoder | trait | Encode exactly one configured PCM frame to one raw codec packet. This method is called by a worker, never the audio device callback.
